sources.note: Inter-University Council for East Africa (IUCEA) official call-for-applications page for the EAC Scholarship Programme, Cohort 4. Read in full; this is the awarding body's own page, dated 13 August 2026. Every field of the record was checked against it.
IUCEA's official EACSP Phase II (2026 intake) awareness page. Read in full; states 'Applications are not yet open' as of today, confirming no successor cohort call is currently open.
IUCEA official index of open calls. Read in full; the most recent EACSP entry is still the Cohort 4 call of 13 August 2026, with no newer cohort published.
KCA University, a host institution named on the IUCEA page, publishes the same Cohort 4 dates and package. Corroborating host-university page (search-result snippet only, not fetched in full).

University of Dar es Salaam, another host institution named on the IUCEA page, confirming Cohort 4 and the EAC/Germany/KfW backing. Corroborating host-university page (search-result snippet only, not fetched in full).

awarding_body.detail: The page is IUCEA's own call page and names both the EAC and the Federal Republic of Germany (through KfW) as the originating initiative, exactly as the record states.
awarding_body.quote: The Inter-University Council for East Africa (IUCEA) hereby invites suitably qualified nationals of the East African Community (EAC) to apply for Cohort 4 of the KfW-funded Scholarships to pursue Master's studies in an EAC Partner State other than their own.

deadline.detail: The page's published closing date matches the record exactly: 10 September 2026 at 17:00 East Africa Time, for Cohort 4. Applications opened 20 August 2026. That cycle closed 32 days before today (12 October 2026), so the record is not a currently-open opportunity; IUCEA's own Phase II page states applications are not yet open, and no Cohort 5 call is published.
deadline.quote: Opening date**20 August 2026** Closing date**10 September 2026 · 17:00 EAT**

eligibility.detail: All four distinct eligibility claims in the record are confirmed on the page: citizenship of one of the eight EAC Partner States (Burundi, DR Congo, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania, Uganda); below 35 years of age; a Bachelor's degree with Second Class Upper Division, Distinction or equivalent; and study at an eligible Master's programme in an EAC Partner State other than the applicant's country of citizenship. The two-application requirement (university admission plus a separate online scholarship application) is also confirmed.
eligibility.quote: Be a citizen of any of the 8 EAC Partner States; Be below 35 years of age at the time of application; Apply to study in an EAC Partner State other than their country of citizenship; Possess a Bachelor's Degree, with a minimum of Second Class Upper Division, Distinction or equivalent qualification;)

funding.detail: The award is fully funded and goes beyond tuition: full tuition fees paid to the host university, a return economy air ticket, a EUR 380 monthly stipend, a EUR 200 arrival allowance, EUR 650 for study materials, a one-time EUR 1,500 study and research allowance, medical insurance, and visa/entry fees. The record's 'Fully Funded' claim is supported.
funding.quote: Full tuition fees payable directly to the host university. ... A monthly stipend of EUR 380 to cover accommodation, meals, local transport and other living expenses. ... Medical insurance coverage for the duration of the scholarship. ... Visa/ Entry fee: Where payment of entry pass into the host country or student pass is required.

degree_levels.detail: Only Master's level is offered. Every one of the 60 eligible programmes listed on the page is a Master's programme (MSc, M Tech, MA, MBA), and the call is titled 'Two-Year Funded Master's Scholarships' with a stated duration of 2 years.
degree_levels.quote: Scholarship duration**2 Years** Available awards**Up to 120 Scholarships**

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Record is factually accurate but describes a closed cycle. Cohort 4 ran 20 August - 10 September 2026 (17:00 EAT) and closed 32 days before this check; results were to be communicated in December 2026. As of 12 October 2026 no EACSP cohort call is open: IUCEA's Phase II page (https://iucea.org/eacsp2/) states 'Applications are not yet open' and the call index (https://iucea.org/call-for-applications/) still lists the 13 August 2026 Cohort 4 call as the latest. Do not present this record as an open opportunity; monitor the IUCEA call-for-applications index for the next cohort. Companion note for the next re-check: the 60 eligible programmes sit at host universities in Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda and Tanzania only, although applicants may come from all eight EAC Partner States.

notes_for_reviewer: The verdict is needs_review rather than active only because the deadline is past: every substantive claim (awarding body, deadline text, eligibility, funding, degree levels) was confirmed against IUCEA's own page, and nothing in the record was contradicted. A human should decide whether to keep the card visible as an archived/closed opportunity or hold it until the next cohort is announced. One caution for the next check: Phase II began in October 2025 and is stated to support at least 280 students across three cohorts, so a further cohort after Cohort 4 may not be imminent and the record could stay closed for some time.
